description:
Maven/Java Modules wrapper activating Dirac (MicroProfile Metrics 5.1) in a vidocq deployment.
        The integration relies on dirac-cdi-vauban's BuildCompatibleExtension (discovery of
        @Counted/@Timed/@Gauge + @ApplicationScoped MetricRegistry producers) and the JAX-RS @Path
        scanning of CassiniExtension, which auto-mounts MetricsResource (@Path("/metrics")). Its one
        Java class, DiracMetricsExtension, only reads the registries for the startup report. The live
        panel of the dev console moved to vidocq-runtime-dirac-metrics-extension-dev (Vidocq/vidocq#143),
        which only vidocq:dev adds.
